name: Archive extraction guard
summary: Block agent-driven archive extraction when entry containment cannot be proven before execution.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that permits archive listing and integrity tests while refusing extraction commands whose entry paths, links, and expansion size cannot be verified without executing the tool.
refuses: It does not extract, rewrite, repair, or delete an archive.
It does not claim that filename-only listing proves archive safety.
It does not accept an inline flag or environment variable as approval.

entrypoints.purpose: Recognize archive listing versus extraction and deterministically refuse unverified expansion.
